verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an official CLI, `clai`, explicitly designed to let users 'chat with various LLMs and quickly get answers, right from the command line,' and any Agent can be launched into this natural-language CLI mode via `to_cli_sync()`. This directly satisfies operating the product via natural-language commands, well documented across multiple doc pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the `clai` CLI experience (community evidence covers the broader framework, not this CLI feature).
